policy.declared_area_s11: A business is in a declared area if its primary place of operation is in a local government area named in the disaster declaration for the event.
policy.eligible_applicant_s12: An applicant is eligible if the applicant owns the business, or holds written authority from the owner to apply on the owner's behalf.
policy.small_business_s13: A small business employs fewer than twenty full-time equivalent staff and has an annual turnover under ten million dollars.
policy.registration_s14: The business must have held an active ABN before the day the disaster event started.
policy.direct_damage_s15: Damage is direct if the disaster event caused it. Loss of trade, loss of custom, and a fall in demand are not direct damage.
policy.eligible_costs_s16: Eligible costs are clean-up, disposal of damaged stock, repair of premises, and replacement of damaged plant. Wages, rent, and insurance excesses are not eligible.
policy.insurance_offset_s18: The grant is reduced by the amount an insurer has paid or will pay for the same item. A pending claim must be resolved before payment.
policy.no_duplication_s21: The grant is not payable for a cost already met by another government grant for the same event.
policy.evidence_guideline_4_2: Evidence levels: none; the applicant's own statement only; third-party quotes or photographs; itemised invoices or receipts that cover the claimed costs.
policy.escalation_guideline_6_1: A senior assessor must see a case that shows a conflict of interest, a repeat claim for the same premises, or an amount above the delegate's limit.

business_in_declared_area.instructions: Is the business's primary place of operation in a local government area named in `event.declared_lgas`, as `policy.declared_area_s11` requires?

criteria.true: The business location is one of the declared areas for this event.
criteria.false: The business location is outside every declared area, or no declaration covers the event.

applicant_is_owner.instructions: Does `applicant.role` show that the applicant owns the business, or holds written authority to apply for the owner, as `policy.eligible_applicant_s12` requires?

business_is_small.instructions: Do `business.employee_count` and `business.annual_turnover_aud` meet the small business test in `policy.small_business_s13`?

abn_active_before_event.instructions: Was the ABN in `business.abn` active before `event.occurred_at`, as `policy.registration_s14` requires?

criteria.true: The ABN was registered and active before the day the event started.
criteria.false: The ABN was registered on or after that day, or was not active.

direct_damage_established.instructions: Does `damage.description` describe damage the event caused directly, and not lost trade, under `policy.direct_damage_s15`?

costs_are_eligible.instructions: Is every item in `costs.items` an eligible cost under `policy.eligible_costs_s16`?

no_duplicate_assistance.instructions: Is every claimed cost free of another government grant for the same event, listed in `other_assistance.grants_received`, under `policy.no_duplication_s21`?

insurance_overlap.instructions: Which insurance position applies to the claimed costs, given `insurance.policy_status`, `insurance.claim_status`, and `insurance.settlement_aud`? Use `policy.insurance_offset_s18`.

criteria.not_insured: The business held no policy that covers the claimed items.
criteria.insured_no_claim: A policy covers the items but the business has made no claim.
criteria.claim_pending: A claim is open and the insurer has not decided it.
criteria.partially_settled: The insurer has paid part of the claimed items.
criteria.fully_settled: The insurer has paid, or will pay, every claimed item in full.
criteria.none_of_the_above: The position does not fit any option above.

evidence_quality.instructions: How well do `evidence.documents` and `evidence.invoice_captions` substantiate the claimed costs? Use the levels in `policy.evidence_guideline_4_2`.
criteria: No evidence of the claimed costs.
Third-party quotes or photographs, but no invoices.
Itemised invoices or receipts that cover the claimed costs.

needs_senior.instructions: Do `case.flags` and `case.claimed_amount_aud` show a case that a senior assessor must see under `policy.escalation_guideline_6_1`?
